# washr

The goal of `washr` is to provide tools to make the [openwashdata data
package](https://openwashdata.org/pages/gallery/data/) workflow
consistent and efficient.

## Installation

The easiest way to get started with `washr` is by installing it from
CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("washr")
```

To get the latest version, you can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("openwashdata/washr")
```

## How to use washr

To learn more about `washr`, check out the ‘Get Started’ page. This,
along with the ‘Reference’ page, will give you a good overview of the
toolkit.

If you decide to use `washr` for publishing your data (which we hope you
will!), take a look at our [detailed
guide](https://global-health-engineering.github.io/ghedatapublishing/).
It’s regularly updated and walks you through the entire process.

# Package index

## Using washr

### Setting up your data repository

- [`setup_rawdata()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/setup_rawdata.md)
  : Create the data-raw directory with a data-processing.R template

### Documenting your data

Helper functions to document both your dataset(s) and functions

- [`setup_dictionary()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/setup_dictionary.md)
  : Create a dictionary file for tidy data sets
- [`fill_dictionary()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/fill_dictionary.md)
  : Fill in the dictionary file based on the tidy data information
- [`setup_roxygen()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/setup_roxygen.md)
  : Set up roxygen documentation for all tidy data sets using the
  dictionary
- [`generate_roxygen_docs()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/generate_roxygen_docs.md)
  : Generate roxygen2 documentation from a CSV file

### Adding metadata

Helper functions to add metadata

- [`update_citation()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/update_citation.md)
  : Update the citation file for the dataset.
- [`update_description()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/update_description.md)
  : Update the DESCRIPTION file to conform with openwashdata standards
- [`add_creator()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/add_creator.md)
  : Add contributors to the creators metadata file
- [`add_metadata()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/add_metadata.md)
  : Adds metadata files and creates the metadata folder
- [`generate_jsonld()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/generate_jsonld.md)
  : Function to create a JSON-LD document from available metadata
- [`update_gsheet_metadata()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/update_gsheet_metadata.md)
  : Updates metadata google sheet automatically
- [`update_metadata()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/update_metadata.md)
  : Updates all metadata files simultaneously
- [`update_biblio()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/update_biblio.md)
  : Function to update the biblio metadata file
- [`update_access()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/update_access.md)
  : Updates the access metadata file with links to the downloadable data
  files
- [`update_attributes()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/update_attributes.md)
  : Update metadata attributes file

### Publishing your data

Helper functions to communicate your data

- [`setup_readme()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/setup_readme.md)
  : Generate the README RMarkdown file
- [`setup_website()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/setup_website.md)
  : Set up a pkgdown website for the data package
- [`use_brand()`](https://openwashdata-dev.github.io/washr/reference/use_brand.md)
  : Install or refresh the openwashdata brand in the active package
